review_outcome: Admission-ready for one new physical campus. The literal code-to-address gap that held HKG10 in rounds 2 and 8 is closed by Goodman's own HKG10 listing, captured as an Internet Archive raw replay whose payload matches the archive index digest. The listing places HKG10 at 128 Texaco Road, Tsuen Wan, and links its HKG10 feature to Goodman's Texaco data-centre page. Government records then bind the Goodman Texaco Centre to Section A of Lot 472 in D.D. 443, whose Lands Department boundary is the selected locator. Lifecycle uses the same FY26 June 30 WIP rule already applied to six Goodman admissions.

separate_unfinished_work: The inherited CGK host-estate locator still requires a versioned correction before a verified 200-site completion claim. This admission does not certify or alter it.
code_alias_swap_resolution: Goodman's 1Q FY26 material (and, per the round2 packet's identity_warning, 1H FY26 material) labels the Tsuen Wan industrial-building redevelopment HKG09 and the Kwai Chung development HKG10. From the Q3 FY26 update (as at 31 March 2026; PDF page 6 table and page 7 panel, viewed) onward, Goodman labels Kwai Chung HKG09 and the Tsuen Wan conversion HKG10. The selected FY26 row itself states 'Conversion of existing industrial building located in Tsuen Wan', and the August 2026 listing binds HKG10 to 128 Texaco Road, so the binding is date-specific and carries the locality in the same row. No older code alias is merged, and the admitted HKG09 Kwai Chung row is unaffected.
archive_route_policy_note: The literal HKG10-to-128 Texaco Road binding comes from an Internet Archive raw replay of Goodman's own page, whose live origin returns HTTP 403 to automated clients (bot management, not login or robots). web.archive.org/robots.txt returns HTTP 404 (captured by the synthesis reviewer, tmp/research-round43-synthesis/robots-web-archive-org.txt.metadata.json) and hk.goodman.com/robots.txt allows the path. The route follows the archived-company-disclosure precedent of the Edgnex and GreenSquareDC admissions. If the parent treats an origin bot-management 403 as access control that an archive replay must not route around, HKG10 reverts to hold on the round2/round8 literal-binding ground.
